# data-droid-hub

> Zero-proxy Rust data extraction Actors and MCP-ready intelligence pipelines on Apify Store.

- Canonical Publisher Profile: https://apify.com/data-droid-hub
- GitHub Pages Hub: https://dandyzicky.github.io/data-droid-hub/
- Primary Stack: Compiled Rust, HTTP/2 pooled RPC (`rustls`), zero headless browser overhead, Apify Pay-Per-Event (PPE), Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## Published Actors

- [Google Ads Transparency Scraper (`data-droid-hub/google-ads-transparency-actor`)](https://apify.com/data-droid-hub/google-ads-transparency-actor): Zero-proxy Rust scraper for Google Ads Transparency Center. Extracts active and historical text, image, and YouTube video creatives, ad copy, landing domains, and per-country reach in 0.2s–1.2s using 256 MB RAM. Supports `domain_summary` qualification, `dryRun` cost estimation, and `onlyNewSinceLastRun` incremental daily diffs.

## Extended Documentation

- [Full Technical & Schema Reference](https://dandyzicky.github.io/data-droid-hub/llms-full.txt): Benchmarks, Pay-Per-Event pricing tables, full JSON input/output schemas, Python/Node.js/MCP integration examples, and FAQ.
